description_en: Performs a paged query on the web filtering rules. Supports paging and exact filtering by web filtering template ID, rule ID, and rule action
description_zh: 分页查询Web过滤规则列表。支持按Web过滤模板ID、规则ID和规则动作精确过滤
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw list-web-filter-rules --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --web-filter-template-id wft-3f2a9c1d4b5e6f70 --web-filter-rule-id wfr-8c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d --rule-action Deny --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListWebFilterRules

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值需大于等于1，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the web filtering template for exact matching
parameters.name: web_filter_template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the web filtering rule for exact matching
parameters.name: web_filter_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The rule action for exact matching. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the request.
Alert: Monitors the request.
Deny: Blocks the request
parameters.help_zh:
规则动作，精确匹配。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
parameters.name: rule_action

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Rules.description_en: The list of web filtering rules

Conditions.description_en: The list of match conditions for the rule. The list contains only one condition
Conditions.description_zh: 规则的匹配条件列表，仅包含1个条件

Key.description_en: The type of the match condition. Valid values: URL, which indicates matching by URL
Key.description_zh: 匹配条件的类型。取值仅支持URL，表示按URL匹配

Values.description_en: The URL to match. A single asterisk () matches all URLs. A value ending with / indicates prefix wildcard matching
Values.description_zh: 匹配的URL。单独星号（）表示匹配全部URL，以/结尾表示前缀通配匹配

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the web filtering rule was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: Web过滤规则的创建时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

RuleAction.description_en:
The action performed after the rule is matched. Valid values:
Allow: Allows the request.
Alert: Monitors the request.
Deny: Blocks the request
RuleAction.description_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the web filtering rule was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: Web过滤规则的最近修改时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

WebFilterRuleId.description_en: The ID of the web filtering rule

WebFilterTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the web filtering template to which the rule belongs

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of web filtering rules that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的Web过滤规则总数
